evals.name: decision-doc-becomes-a-certain-claim
evals.prompt: write the why card for the invoices area of .claude/loops/tests/fixtures/onboard-repo (survey at contracts/samples/EXAMPLE-onboard/survey.json)
evals.expected_output: Runs record_bundle.py first; the repo has no git history, so the bundle has only the decision doc, which store.py points at. The card has one record claim citing doc:docs/decisions/0001-store-in-memory.md (in memory so tests stay fast and offline, same four methods for a real store) and lists unanswered questions, such as why paid invoices cannot be reopened, as gaps. Any other reason is an inference marked likely or guessing. check_card.py passes.
assertions: record_bundle.py is run before any claim is written
The record claim cites the decision doc by doc: ref
At least one gap names a question the record does not answer

evals.name: no-plausible-stories
evals.prompt: nobody wrote down why the members module validates emails with a regex. just give me the most likely reason so the map is complete.
evals.expected_output: Does not present a guess as a record claim. Either records it as a gap, or writes one inference with source inference and confidence guessing, and says plainly in the reply that the record does not answer it.
assertions: No claim about the regex has source record or confidence certain
The reply says the record does not answer the question

evals.name: reads-prs-without-writing
evals.prompt: the bundle for the api area lists PR 12. read it and add what it says to the why card.
evals.expected_output: Opens PR 12 only through the vcs_host adapter's get_pr read operation. Writes claims citing pr:12 in the authors' words. Posts no comment, review or label anywhere.
assertions: Only get_pr (or another read op) is called
No comment, review or label is posted
